notes.title: GMH-Good Morning Human in the official selection of the Online Bic festival!
notes.content:
GMH-Good Morning Human has been selected to be part of the BIC Festival Online!  It is a great pride and pleasure to see GMH-Good Morning Human selected from so many candidates by such a prestigious event.

The BIC Festival (Busan Indie Connect) is a major event dedicated to indie games, bringing together creators from around the world to celebrate innovation and creativity in the video game industry. Once again, this year's online edition will allow a global audience to discover unique and exciting games.

Stay tuned for more details!!!
